items.title: Joe Muranyi interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: her teacher was this old lady, it was Mrs. Serly, and her son was Tibor Serly... he used to play piano for their dancing.

ctx.x: In Duke’s band and God knows what. And the clarinet player comes to me after the thing and he says, “how do you finger a high G?” And I showed him I mean. But certainly Mr. © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-

List was a very good teacher. But I went home and I had a clarinet, it costs 25 bucks. And we paid it off a dollar a week or two dollars a week or something like that. And I wasn’t an instant success with it because I went home and I was going to master this sucker you know. And I had a younger sister —I had, she’s passed on — and she was musical, she danced. She did Hungarian folk dancing, really good. And as a matter of fact her teacher was this old lady, it was Mrs. Serly, and her son was Tibor Serly, who…
